snippet.title: Tamer: King of Dinosaurs - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Support Us Here! ⬇⬇⬇⬇⬇

Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026730/Tamer_King_of_Dinosaurs/

Support our Game Development:
https://www.patreon.com/RidetheLionStudios

Embark on an unparalleled journey with "Tamer: King of Dinosaurs" (Tamer: KoD), where survival meets epic storytelling in a realm where dinosaurs rule supreme. This adult (18+) game blends action, survival, and a story-driven romance unlike any other currently available.

"Tamer: King of Dinosaurs" is a world-first in the adult gaming industry. Our proprietary full-body performance capture technology is brought to life by a talented cast of professional theater performers. These actors deliver intensity and passion to the game’s characters, so that every romance scene, every conflict, and every triumph is deeply rooted in the context of our expansive story.

"Tamer: King of Dinosaurs" is a single player, one time purchase, survival/action/dating sim experience. Our interactive world is rich with challenges and discoveries, promising an erotic gameplay experience that is as rewarding as it is thrilling.

On track for a launch in 2025, we invite you to be part of this prehistoric world's unveiling, a testament to what the future of adult gaming can be when a romantic story, motion-capture technology, and great gameplay converge.

Follow Us Here ⬇

Patreon -  https://www.patreon.com/RidetheLionStudios
